integrity: Finite rational and numerical checks support, but do not prove, the stated infinite asymptotics. Source finite identity and classical hyperbola estimate are credited.
scientific_limitations: Pointwise fixed-parameter asymptotics only; no uniform crossover or optimal error estimates. Priority is qualified because an unindexed equivalent may exist; classical divisor estimates are borrowed and credited.
title: A three-regime summatory law for generalized Dineva divisor weights
